**Windows:** download **PokePet-Setup.exe**, open it, and your pet appears on screen.
Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" because the installer isn't signed yet: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**Android:** download **PokePet.apk** on your phone and open it. If Android asks, allow your browser to install apps, then tap **Install**.
Play Protect may say the app is unknown because it isn't on the Play Store yet: tap **More details**, then **Install anyway**.
